en.title: Retro Room to open brick-and-mortar store in Chesterfield next month
en.description: Nicole and Luke Baab, who have operated Retro Room for eight years through a subscription service and pop‑up events, announced plans to open a perm...
en.fullContent:
Nicole and Luke Baab, who have operated Retro Room for eight years through a subscription service and pop‑up events, announced plans to open a permanent retail location at 10060 Robious Road in Chesterfield. The new shop, scheduled to open next month, will specialize in buying, selling, and trading pre‑owned and vintage video games, with inventory that includes titles for the NES, Nintendo 64, as well as more recent releases for Xbox One and PlayStation 5. In addition to games, the store will carry video‑game consoles, related merchandise, and Pokémon cards.

According to Nicole Baab, the store is intended to serve both collectors and families, offering a range of products from the 1980s to the present. She highlighted the goal of providing a space where customers can share gaming experiences, recalling the social aspect of playing titles such as Mario Kart and Sonic together.

Nicole y Luke Baab, quienes han gestionado Retro Room durante ocho años mediante un servicio de suscripción y eventos temporales, anunciaron la apertura de un local permanente en el 10060 Robious Road, Chesterfield. La tienda, programada para abrir el próximo mes, se dedicará a la compra, venta e intercambio de videojuegos usados y vintage, incluyendo títulos para NES, Nintendo 64 y juegos más recientes para Xbox One y PlayStation 5. Además de los videojuegos, el establecimiento ofrecerá consolas, merchandising relacionado y cartas de Pokémon.

Nicole Baab señaló que el objetivo del negocio es atender tanto a coleccionistas como a familias, ofreciendo productos que abarcan desde la década de 1980 hasta la actualidad. Comentó que busca crear un espacio donde los clientes puedan compartir experiencias de juego, recordando la interacción social de títulos como Mario Kart y Sonic.

en.fullContent:
The article notes that recent years have produced a number of video game adaptations in film and television, and it references an earlier list of such titles for additional context. It then highlights several specific productions.

In the live‑action film "Detective Pikachu," Bill Nighy provides the voice of Mewtwo, while Justice Smith and Kathryn Newton portray the characters Tim and Lucy. Ryan Reynolds is credited as the voice of the titular Pikachu, and the story follows Tim's search for his missing father.

The Netflix series based on Capcom's "Devil May Cry" features animation described as sharp, with Hoon Lee portraying the antagonist known as White Rabbit. The first season culminates in a finale that aligns with the source material, and a second season slated for 2026 is reported to focus on the character Vergil. The article also mentions a collaboration between Jim Carrey and Keanu Reeves, identifying their roles as Dr. Robotnik and Shadow the Hedgehog, respectively.

En la película de acción real "Detective Pikachu", Bill Nighy da la voz a Mewtwo, mientras que Justice Smith y Kathryn Newton interpretan a los personajes Tim y Lucy. Ryan Reynolds está acreditado como la voz del Pikachu titular, y la trama sigue la búsqueda de Tim de su padre desaparecido.

La serie de Netflix basada en "Devil May Cry" de Capcom presenta una animación descrita como nítida, con Hoon Lee interpretando al antagonista llamado White Rabbit. La primera temporada concluye con un final alineado con el material original, y se informa que la segunda temporada, prevista para 2026, se centrará en el personaje Vergil. El artículo también menciona una colaboración entre Jim Carrey y Keanu Reeves, identificando sus papeles como Dr. Robotnik y Shadow the Hedgehog, respectivamente.

en.title: Street Fighter Film Scheduled for Release on October 16, 2026
en.description: Fighting games have been a part of the video‑game landscape since its early days, with titles ranging from classic arcade releases such as Mortal K...
en.fullContent:
Fighting games have been a part of the video‑game landscape since its early days, with titles ranging from classic arcade releases such as Mortal Kombat to modern series like Tekken and family‑oriented games such as Super Smash Bros. Street Fighter, a franchise that began in 1987, has remained active through multiple sequels and spin‑offs.

Paramount Pictures announced that a new Street Fighter movie will be released on October 16, 2026. The film is directed by Kitao Sakurai, who also co‑wrote the screenplay with T. J. Fixman. The story is credited to Dalan Musson and Gary Dauberman, known for their work on Captain America: Brave New World and It: Chapter Two, respectively. Noah Centineo has been cast as Ken Masters, with Andrew Koji, Callina Liang and Roman listed among the supporting cast.

The upcoming production follows a 1994 Street Fighter adaptation that received negative reviews. The New York Times described it as "a dreary, overstuffed hodgepodge of poorly edited martial arts sequences and often unintelligible dialogue," while Variety called it "noisy, overblown and effects‑laden and [lacking] sustained action or engaging characters."

es.title: Película de Street Fighter programada para el 16 de octubre de 2026
es.description: Los juegos de lucha forman parte del panorama de los videojuegos desde sus inicios, con títulos que van desde clásicos de arcade como Mortal Kombat...
es.fullContent:
Los juegos de lucha forman parte del panorama de los videojuegos desde sus inicios, con títulos que van desde clásicos de arcade como Mortal Kombat hasta series modernas como Tekken y juegos familiares como Super Smash Bros. Street Fighter, una franquicia que comenzó en 1987, ha continuado activa mediante múltiples secuelas y spin‑offs.

Paramount Pictures anunció que una nueva película de Street Fighter se estrenará el 16 de octubre de 2026. La película está dirigida por Kitao Sakurai, quien también coescribió el guion junto a T. J. Fixman. La historia es atribuida a Dalan Musson y Gary Dauberman, conocidos por su trabajo en Captain America: Brave New World e It: Chapter Two, respectivamente. Noah Centineo interpretará a Ken Masters, con Andrew Koji, Callina Liang y Roman entre el elenco de apoyo.

Esta producción sigue a una adaptación de Street Fighter de 1994 que recibió críticas negativas. The New York Times la describió como "un revoltijo sombrío y sobrecargado de secuencias de artes marciales pobremente editadas y diálogos a menudo ininteligibles", mientras que Variety la calificó de "ruidosa, exagerada y cargada de efectos, sin acción sostenida ni personajes atractivos".

en.title: Hideo Kojima says Sony ended partnership during Zoom call without explanation
en.description: Hideo Kojima told The Washington Post, through an interpreter, that Sony Interactive Entertainment informed him of the termination of their long‑st...
en.fullContent:
Hideo Kojima told The Washington Post, through an interpreter, that Sony Interactive Entertainment informed him of the termination of their long‑standing partnership during a Zoom meeting. According to Kojima, the company did not provide a reason for the decision.

The video call, held in June, included Kojima, his translator Aki Saito, and Shinji Hirano, president of Kojima Productions. Kojima said he was "shocked and surprised" and that his mind went blank when he received the news. He added that he holds no anger or sadness, and is considering the next steps for his studio.

Kojima Productions, whose previous releases such as Death Stranding and Death Stranding 2 launched as PlayStation exclusives, is currently developing the horror game OD in collaboration with Microsoft and a stealth‑action title, Physint, featuring Bill Skarsgård. Kojima indicated that Sony's cancellation of its support for Physint has created uncertainty for the studio and its employees.

es.title: Hideo Kojima afirma que Sony terminó la colaboración en una llamada de Zoom sin explicar motivos
es.description: Hideo Kojima declaró al Washington Post, a través de un intérprete, que Sony Interactive Entertainment le comunicó la terminación de su alianza de ...
es.fullContent:
Hideo Kojima declaró al Washington Post, a través de un intérprete, que Sony Interactive Entertainment le comunicó la terminación de su alianza de larga data durante una reunión por Zoom. Según Kojima, la empresa no ofreció una razón para la decisión.

La videollamada, celebrada en junio, contó con la participación de Kojima, su traductor Aki Saito y Shinji Hirano, presidente de Kojima Productions. Kojima explicó que se sintió "sorprendido y atónito" y que su mente quedó en blanco al recibir la noticia. Añadió que no siente ira ni tristeza y que está evaluando los próximos pasos para su estudio.

Kojima Productions, cuyas anteriores entregas como Death Stranding y Death Stranding 2 se lanzaron como exclusivas de PlayStation, está trabajando actualmente en el juego de terror OD en colaboración con Microsoft y en el título de acción sigilosa Physint, con Bill Skarsgård. Kojima señaló que la cancelación del apoyo de Sony a Physint ha generado incertidumbre para el estudio y sus empleados.
